integrity: A direct proof is supplied; a standalone exact-rational and numerical checker verifies only finite algebra and normalization, not the infinite-dimensional claim.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed positive rate pairs and a common vanishing mesh are treated; the limiting operator is explicit but its individual singular values are not evaluated in closed form. Historical priority needs specialist confirmation. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
